verdict.rationale: Whether a password manager's source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The pack never shows 1Password's own app source under an open license. The only GitHub item is the JS SDK repository, a developer building block for integrations rather than the product's source, and no license is stated for it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
